annotations.text:
Spatial Solid

One visual language, three products.

Depth comes from an opaque lightness step + a hairline + a 7% inner top highlight — never from transparency, so dense protocol data stays readable at every level.

Accent mint is reserved for energy, charging and the primary action. Everything else is ink.

Chart marks use their own lightness band (OKLCH L 0.48–0.67 dark, 0.43–0.77 light), separate from the UI ink which is tuned for 4.5:1 text contrast.

Both palettes were run through the colorblind-separation validator: the 2-series protocol palette passes every check in both modes.

The CPMS and the Simulator are separate products with separate interfaces — they only ever talk to each other over OCPP.

The simulator takes blue as its brand accent so you always know which window you are looking at.
